description: Adds a hand-written quiz question to one atom (sop_id) of a module, as Add question does (owner or admin seats only): question_text, two or more choices ({ key, text, is_correct }, one correct), explanation, optional image_url. A quiz question tests a lesson; it is not how to add new content to training: "add this to training" puts the text in a handbook article in the module (edit_training_module). Before adding anything to the handbook, search the sops read entity by the topic (search finds by meaning): when an article already covers it, put the new text into that article (edit_handbook_article with its full content_md, the new lines placed where they belong, or draft_handbook_edit) instead of a new one; create a new article only when none fits, and say which closest article you found and why it did not fit. Audience comes from the person's words: cleaner SOPs, cleaning standards or staff = cleaner; policies, office or VA = va; when the words do not say, ask in one line. Ask which place, in one line naming both, when two places fit the person's words equally well: two articles, or two training modules that both match (two new-hire modules are a tie whatever their status, draft or published); a place the person named outright is never a tie. The proposed change is the confirmation, so never ask "should I add this?" first. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same question.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.
